selection.rule: Dependency-complete first 24 questions from the question-sheet selection order.

questions.question: In the passage, what are two main ways Allah’s Essence is made known?
questions.answer: It is made known through revelation and inspiration on one side, and through created works and their effects on the other.

questions.question: Why are the products of Power compared to outward words?
questions.answer: Because they carry meaning and communicate the reality of the One behind them.

questions.question: What does the passage teach about the created world as a whole?
questions.answer: It teaches that the whole world can be understood as a meaningful display pointing to Allah.

questions.question: Besides its own direct proofs, what other evidences support Life?
questions.answer: The signs of Power, the indications of Knowledge, and the proofs belonging to the other Divine attributes also support it.

questions.question: What does the passage call the Divine Essence shown by Life?
questions.answer: Ever-living and self-subsisting.

questions.question: What does the continual transformation of the universe indicate?
questions.answer: It indicates living activity that constantly brings forth new displays.

questions.question: What argument does the passage make from Knowledge, Hearing, Seeing, Will, Power with purpose, and Speech to Life?
questions.answer: It argues that these qualities belong properly to one who is living, so their presence points to Divine Life.

questions.question: Why does Speech especially support both Life and Knowledge?
questions.answer: Because speaking meaningfully belongs to one who is alive and aware.

questions.question: What does it mean that Life is the “foundation and source” of the attributes?
questions.answer: It means the other attributes are understood as resting upon and flowing from Life.

questions.question: How does the final sentence encourage humility in study?
questions.answer: It reminds the reader that the subject is much larger than this short treatment and that only a small part has been presented.

questions.question: What comparison is made between Speech and Power at the start of the passage?
questions.answer: Both make Allah known, but Speech does so through revelation and inspiration, while Power does so through created works.

questions.question: What does the passage say Power does for the human understanding of Allah?
questions.answer: It introduces Allah through the visible excellence and effects of created things.

questions.question: What title-like description of Allah is highlighted through the proof from Power?
questions.answer: A glorious possessor of power.

questions.question: Why do administration and adornment matter in the proof from Knowledge?
questions.answer: They show intentional arrangement and precise awareness, not randomness.

questions.question: How does the passage strengthen the proof of Life beyond a simple statement?
questions.answer: It layers together many lines of evidence from multiple attributes and from all living beings.

questions.question: According to the passage, why is the cosmos constantly changing?
questions.answer: To display ever-new manifestations and forms.

questions.question: What do these living witnesses reflect?
questions.answer: They reflect many evidences of Divine attributes.

questions.question: How do Seeing and Hearing function in the argument?
questions.answer: They reveal the Divine Essence and at the same time indicate Life.

questions.question: Why is purposive power treated as evidence of life?
questions.answer: Because power directed toward aims belongs to one that is living and aware.

questions.question: What function does revelation and inspiration serve in this passage?
questions.answer: They are means by which the attribute of Speech makes Allah known.

questions.question: What picture is used for the whole universe in relation to Power?
questions.answer: The universe is pictured as a meaningful, embodied book that points to a majestic and powerful Creator.

questions.question: What kind of Creator is indicated by this meaningful cosmos?
questions.answer: One who is powerful and majestic.

questions.question: Why does the passage stress that creatures are made distinct?
questions.answer: Because individuality within order suggests detailed knowledge, not blind process.

questions.question: Why does the passage connect constant change in the cosmos to Life?
questions.answer: Because ongoing renewal produces fresh forms and displays, showing living activity rather than dead stillness.
